objective: Test whether retaining UPRO/SPXU/SPY as the sensing system while replacing costly SPXU bearish execution with SH improves the unchanged expanding-memory algorithm enough to beat passive SPY.
evidence_warning: The substitution is motivated by repeated historical SPXU execution failures. This is a frozen mechanism test, not independent discovery. A passing result would require future paper validation.

sensor_layer.features: The exact same 12 SPY/UPRO/SPXU morning features
sensor_layer.standardization: Expanding prior-session median and interquartile range only
sensor_layer.neighbors: Ceiling of square root of prior valid sessions, uniform weight
sensor_layer.trade_gate: Higher forecast must be positive and more than half of its neighbors profitable

actuator_layer.bullish: Long $100 fractional UPRO at observed 11:01 ask
actuator_layer.bearish: Long $100 fractional SH at observed 11:01 ask
actuator_layer.upro_catastrophe_stop: SPY 3.333333% below its 11:01 open, approximating a 10% adverse UPRO move
actuator_layer.sh_catastrophe_stop: SPY 10% above its 11:01 open, approximating a 10% adverse SH move

new_data.primary: Databento ARCX.PILLAR SH bbo-1m from 2021-01-01 through 2026-07-24
new_data.audit: Databento EQUS.MINI SH bbo-1m from 2023-03-28 through 2026-07-24
new_data.SH_signal_data: None; SH is an execution actuator only
new_data.existing_SH_bars: Not used for signals or fills

potential_outcomes.UPRO: Unchanged executable UPRO outcome from v7
potential_outcomes.SH: Executable SH ask-to-bid return with the actuator-specific catastrophe stop
potential_outcomes.memory_update: Both potential outcomes are revealed to the online algorithm only after the session close

evaluation.primary_period: First model-eligible session after 125 valid memories through 2026-07-24
evaluation.primary_feed: ARCX.PILLAR for continuity over the full period
evaluation.consolidated_audit: Rerun the frozen choices and SH outcome memory using EQUS.MINI only where complete overlap permits; report separately and do not select the favorable feed

acceptance_criteria.must_improve_on_v7_SPXU_actuator: Ending cash above $125.2279 and profit factor above 1.0548

prohibited_repairs: Change sensor features, neighbor logic, majority gate, or minimum memory.
Use SH prices or outcomes as sensor features.
Change $100 notional, entry, exit, or actuator-specific stops after results.
Select only UPRO, only SH, a year, month, score threshold, or favorable feed.
Tune a confidence or expected-return buffer on observed outcomes.
Claim independence from the preceding research lineage.
